name: Distributed Systems
syllabusSummary: Consensus protocols, Raft, Paxos, RPC mechanisms, distributed transactions, fault tolerance, and vector clocks.

name: Cloud Computing Architecture
syllabusSummary: Virtualization, container orchestration with Kubernetes, serverless paradigms, multi-tenant isolation, and cloud security.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
scheduleSummary: Mon, Wed, Fri: 10:00 - 11:30 AM | Tue (Lab): Lab-101
syllabusSummary: Balanced search trees, hashing, graph traversal, dynamic programming, greedy paradigms, amortized complexity analysis.

name: Database Management Systems
syllabusSummary: Relational algebra, SQL query optimization, B+ Tree indexing, ACID transactions, 2PL concurrency, write-ahead logging.

name: Machine Learning Foundations
syllabusSummary: Supervised learning, gradient descent optimization, SVMs, decision trees, ensemble methods, clustering, and PCA.

name: Deep Learning & NLP
syllabusSummary: Convolutional networks, recurrent architectures, transformers, self-attention, large language models, and tokenization.

name: Signals & Linear Systems
syllabusSummary: Continuous and discrete signals, LTI systems, Fourier series, Fourier transform, Laplace transform, and Z-transform.

name: Microprocessors & Microcontrollers
syllabusSummary: ARM Cortex architecture, assembly programming, bus protocols, DMA controllers, timer interrupts, and peripheral interfacing.

name: Linear Algebra & Calculus
syllabusSummary: Vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, multivariable calculus, and Stokes theorem.

name: Probability & Stochastic Processes
syllabusSummary: Probability axioms, random variables, joint distributions, central limit theorem, Markov chains, and Poisson processes.

name: Thermodynamics & Heat Transfer
syllabusSummary: First and second laws of thermodynamics, entropy, power cycles, conduction, convection, and radiation heat transfer.

name: Fluid Dynamics & Aerodynamics
syllabusSummary: Navier-Stokes equations, boundary layer theory, inviscid flow, compressible aerodynamics, and vortex dynamics.
